description_zh: 碰撞因皮卡倒车导致，核心机动为倒车/后退，属于可辩护排除范围。
reason: 核心机动涉及倒车（reverse/backing），CARLA 无法实现，且属于 NHTSA 非 V2V 子集。

source_snippets: The Cruise AV approached a pickup truck that was reversing on eastbound Greenwich Street and the Cruise AV stopped as the pickup truck continued to reverse.
The pickup truck continued to reverse and made contact with the Cruise AV, damaging the front bumper of the Cruise AV.
VEH 1: A. STOPPED, VEH 2: G. BACKING
